purpose: Offline merge and raw OHLCV continuity diagnosis of 90 current THS A industries and 11 same-source HK industries; no accounts and no algorithm changes

selection_frozen_before_chart_review.reason: A bank: user requested existing representative
A semiconductor: user requested existing representative
A planting/forestry: smallest numeric current A industry ID, deterministic without selecting by returns
HK financials: explicitly requested and known gap verification
HK information technology: explicitly requested and known long gap
HK raw materials: explicitly requested; show short coverage as obtained

price_observation_policy: Frozen data_utils.eligible_prices; missing volume alone does not delete a valid price observation
volume_units: Unscaled source index turnover units; no claim of stock-share units or cross-industry comparability; overlap checked per series; no index-price VWAP inference
continuity_diagnostics: Report all date intervals over 10 calendar days and missing dates relative to same-market union calendar. Flag intervals over 20 days as candidate source breaks, not an automatic financial trend rule. Known HK gaps have separate targeted-query evidence.
missing_calendar_caveat: Union calendar is an empirical comparison, not a certified exchange schedule. Holidays and actual index start must be distinguished from source gaps.
